title: 원숭이 입 모양 만들기
instruction: 입술 안쪽에서 혀로 윗입술과 아랫입술을 번갈아 밀어주세요.
caption: 혀로 윗입술과 아랫입술 안쪽을 번갈아 미세요.
motion_prompt: Keep the lips softly closed. Move the tongue inside the mouth to push the upper lip outward from behind, return, then push the lower lip outward from behind, creating a gentle monkey-face shape, then relax.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: relaxed softly CLOSED lips, tongue NOT visible
tongue stays INSIDE closed mouth and gently pushes the UPPER lip outward from behind; upper lip bulges forward, no external tongue; cheeks and chin adapt
tongue stays INSIDE closed mouth and gently pushes the LOWER lip outward from behind; lower lip bulges forward, no external tongue; cheeks and chin adapt
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for tongue_09_monkey_lips. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Use the attached adult Korean female illustrated therapist as the exact character and style reference. Same face, dark ponytail, white uniform, warm clinic background. Same front-facing head-and-shoulders framing in every tile, mouth and whole jaw clearly visible, same scale and head position, calm gaze. Render each WHOLE face as coherent artwork, including coordinated lip corners, cheeks, jaw, chin and natural linework, texture and shadows. No separately pasted vector mouth. Head/camera stable; jaw moves naturally for lip shapes, remains stable for independent tongue exercises. Tile poses: TILE 1: relaxed softly CLOSED lips, tongue NOT visible. TILE 2: tongue stays INSIDE closed mouth and gently pushes the UPPER lip outward from behind; upper lip bulges forward, no external tongue; cheeks and chin adapt. TILE 3: tongue stays INSIDE closed mouth and gently pushes the LOWER lip outward from behind; lower lip bulges forward, no external tongue; cheeks and chin adapt. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
